Remark
[constant curvature and the double warped-product representation of hyperbolic space]

Source: petersen:page-0173 ↗ thm:pet-ch4-rotsym-curvature-operator 1. ch4:4.7.10Let $(M^n,g)=(I\times N,dr^2+\rho ^2(r)g_N)$ have constant curvature $k$. (1) Show $(N^{n-1},\rho ^2(r)g_N)$ has constant curvature $k+(\dot\rho /\rho )^2$ if $n>2$. (2) Show explicitly that hyperbolic space is a warped product over both hyperbolic space and Euclidean space.
